note: Frozen before any KN runtime exists. Latency, stages, workload and TS gates are inherited unchanged from the v2.1.1 budget by hash; resource and retention values are measured or derived from measurements named below. A missed target is an open exit, never a threshold edited after results.

latency_quantities.rule: Owner rule 2026-09-18: every endpoint benchmark reports all four, with unit, measurement point and sample count.
latency_quantities.request_latency: SDK call in the consumer container until the decoded, validated result is usable; cold and warm connections reported separately
latency_quantities.durable_event_age: age of the served record at response time from the source/component/BAR-close timestamp named in the response
latency_quantities.delivery_lag: provider event (BAR: close time) to canonical publish; host receive and Kafka commit as sub-spans
latency_quantities.end_to_end_cache: provider event (BAR: close time) to the state being applied at the alpha/TS client

throughput_challenge.rule: canonical records from real capture or live, not raw frames or synthetic tiny events; accelerated replay is never reported as live freshness

baseline_measured.window: 60 samples x 10 s, 2026-09-23 18:21Z, quiet market, backlog drained
baseline_measured.note: the running design already exceeds the 5.0 budget at a quiet rate; KN must remove work, not only stay equal

target_allocation_vcpu_unverified.status: hypothesis to verify in KN-2..KN-5; not a result

stop_conditions: old projector group lag grows for 5 minutes

kafka.note: canonical carries the full raw envelope header and is larger than raw; removing it is out of KN scope (KD13)

market_cache.process: separate Redis process and config from the control/quota/admission Redis (KD10)
market_cache.image: same redis image digest as stable_redis
market_cache.bar_row_encoding: compact typed record (decimal strings exact, integer ns times, final, revision, event id)
market_cache.bar_layout: per-product hash buckets of 120 opens in listpack encoding; open time in integer milliseconds

sizing.retained_opens_cap_rule: demanded rows + 2064 headroom per product (10,000 -> 12,064; VN 500 -> 2,564)
sizing.staging_rebuild: full staging generation beside the ready one
sizing.status: starting cap for KN-3; re-measured with the real projector and all feeds before promotion

retention.bar_retained_opens_served: the demanded rows of each product (10,000 for alpha crypto, 500 VN, 1,000 TS 1m inside the 10,000)
retention.bar_revision_audit: append-only revision facts kept for every open inside the retained window; below the durable retention floor a tombstone is published
retention.rebuild_horizon: a cache generation offline longer than the tombstone lifetime rebuilds from a fresh generation; it never overlays a cache that may have missed deletes

state_topics.approval: topic creation and ACLs are a separate KN-3 runtime packet

retention.demand_only: only products with manifest demand are materialized; provider wrappers keep serving bounded on-demand history outside the cache
